substeps.caption: The door swings open on its two right-hand hinges; its insulating plug comes out of the chamber's mouth.
A rack of the printed tensile specimens goes in: four ASTM E8 subsize dogbones, 100 mm long, cut off their build plate, standing on end.

Door shut. A T6: solution treatment at about 530 C, a water quench in the tank beside it, then ageing at about 160 C (the schedule is an assumption until DAL sets one). The circulation fan holds +-5 C, so one furnace does both.
